text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no shell in this session, so I checked each fix by reading the code against the tests. Please run the suite to confirm.

- **`search.py`**: it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`**: `MAX_BORROWED` was 3, but the comment and tests say five books. It is now 5.
- **`fees.py`**: the fee was `days_late + DAILY_FEE`. It is now `days_late * DAILY_FEE`.
- **`factory.py`**: `sample_books()` was missing the third title. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`.
- **`inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of its `[-n - 1:]` slice. It now returns the last `n`, and an empty list when `n <= 0`.
- **`books.py`**: `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an int.

I didn't touch the tests.
